selection_reason: Transformerの大きなmemory footprintと低いdata reuseによるmemory bottleneckを対象に、token-based dataflowでinter-layer data movementを削減し、HBMへPIM-NMC hybrid processingを組み込む推論アクセラレータ。既存memory-based accelerator比3.7–9.1x、GPU比22.1–114.9xの高速化を報告し、推論向けPIM/near-memory accelerationに直接該当する。
title: TransPIM: A Memory-based Acceleration via Software-Hardware Co-Design for Transformer
venue: International Symposium on High-Performance Computer Architecture
